generated.description: copied from MANIFEST.json generated for determinism

models.description: sorted unique modelIds (GLM-*, gemini-*, claude-*, gpt-*, kimi-*, ...) plus provider:<templateId> entries from config/provider/*.json

endpoints.description: absolute https?:// URLs and quoted /api//oauth//vN/... paths; ${var} normalized to {}

feature_flags.description: flag-like identifiers: *Enabled/*Disabled minus generic stems, enable_*/disable_*, FF_*, ZCODE_*, features.*, feature_gate_*

env_vars.description: variable names read via process.env.X / process.env['X'] / getenv('X')

plans.description: tier:<name> plan tiers, plan:<snake> plan ids, provider_cls:<Name> subscription/quota provider classes, quota:<field>=<n> numeric limits, kv:<field>=<value> plan/product ids

acp_methods.description: JSON-RPC/ACP method strings: session/*, fs/*, terminal/*, mcp/*, _claude/*, method: values, acp.* events

ipc_channels.description: Electron IPC channel names from app/out (zcode:* plus other non-junk namespaces)

plugins_skills.description: plugin:<name>@<ver>, plugin:<name>:mcp:<server>, skill:<name>, command:<name>, policy:<name>, bundled_pkg:<name>@<ver>

engine.description: engine tag, app name/version, app.asar sha256, host binary sha256, host pkg version, components map (dir->name@ver or path->sha256:...), optional electron_hint

provenance.description: optional: category -> signature -> first source relpath (not part of the diffed surface)
